name: exp_CronexDeMarker
summary: This EA trades based on the Cronex DeMarker oscillator, a smoothed variant of the standard DeMarker indicator. It opens buy positions when the oscillator crosses upward from oversold levels and sell positions when it crosses downward from overbought levels. The system includes customizable DeMarker periods, smoothing methods, and signal line parameters for trade generation.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Cronex DeMarker震荡指标进行交易，这是标准DeMarker指标的平滑变体。当震荡指标从超卖区域向上交叉时开多仓，从超买区域向下交叉时开空仓。系统包含可自定义的DeMarker周期、平滑方法和信号线参数。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Cronex DeMarker震荡指标，该指标通过多重平滑处理使标准DeMarker曲线更加平滑，减少虚假信号。入场条件为：当主线从下方穿越信号线且处于超卖区域时做多，当主线从上方穿越信号线且处于超买区域时做空。出场条件依赖反向交叉信号或可配置的止损止盈设置。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，没有动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面缺少基于账户余额或风险的动态计算，仅支持手动设定手数。整体策略属于动量反转混合型，利用震荡指标的超买超卖区间捕捉价格转折点。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Cronex DeMarker oscillator, which applies multiple smoothing passes to the standard DeMarker curve to reduce false signals. Entry conditions are: go long when the main line crosses above the signal line in the oversold zone, and go short when the main line crosses below the signal line in the overbought zone. Exit conditions rely on reverse crossover signals or configurable stop-loss and take-profit settings. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach with no dynamic position adjustment mechanism. Money management lacks dynamic calculation based on account balance or risk, supporting only manually set lot sizes. The overall strategy is a momentum-reversal hybrid type, capturing price turning points using oscillator overbought and oversold zones.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术号码用于识别订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

pros: 使用多重平滑的DeMarker指标，比原始DeMarker产生更少的虚假信号
超买超卖阈值可配置，允许交易者根据不同市场环境调整灵敏度
信号线交叉机制提供清晰的入场和出场规则，减少主观判断
支持多种平滑方法选择，增加了策略的灵活性
pros_en: Uses multi-smoothed DeMarker indicator, producing fewer false signals than the raw DeMarker
Configurable overbought/oversold thresholds allow traders to adjust sensitivity for different market conditions
Signal line crossover mechanism provides clear entry and exit rules, reducing subjective judgment
Supports multiple smoothing method choices, increasing strategy flexibility
cons: 固定手数交易缺乏动态资金管理，无法根据账户风险自动调整仓位
止损止盈默认值为0，新手用户可能忽略设置导致无限风险暴露
震荡指标在趋势市场中容易产生连续虚假信号导致多次亏损
缺少新K线检测机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
没有包含点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能不利
cons_en: Fixed lot trading lacks dynamic money management, unable to automatically adjust position size based on account risk
Stop-loss and take-profit default to 0, novice users may overlook setting them leading to unlimited risk exposure
Oscillator indicators tend to produce consecutive false signals in trending markets causing multiple losses
Lacks new bar detection mechanism, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same bar
No spread filter included, which may be disadvantageous in high-spread environments
improvements: 增加基于账户余额百分比的动态仓位计算功能，实现合理的资金管理
添加新K线检测和点差过滤机制，避免重复开仓和高成本交易
引入趋势过滤器（如均线方向），在趋势市场中避免逆势操作
增加移动止损功能以锁定浮盈，提升盈利交易的风险回报比
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing based on account balance percentage for proper money management
Add new bar detection and spread filter mechanisms to avoid duplicate entries and high-cost trades
Introduce a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction) to avoid counter-trend trades in trending markets
Add a trailing stop feature to lock in floating profits and improve the risk-reward ratio of winning trades

risk_points: 止损止盈默认值为0，不设置时风险敞口无限
缺少新K线检测，可能在同一K线多次开仓导致过度交易
震荡指标在强趋势市场中可能产生连续亏损信号
固定手数不考虑账户规模变化，存在过度杠杆风险
risk_points_en: Stop-loss and take-profit default to 0, creating unlimited risk exposure when not set
Lacks new bar detection, potentially opening multiple positions on the same bar leading to over-trading
Oscillator may produce consecutive losing signals in strong trending markets
Fixed lot size does not account for account size changes, posing over-leveraging risk
